foramen primum: ok - open gap below the free edge in stage 1, labelled 'foramen primum (gap)' and closed below in stage 2 ('primum shut below')
foramen secundum: ok - perforations in the upper septum primum in stage 2, labelled 'foramen secundum (holes)', and still shown in stage 3

foramen ovale with septum primum flap: ok - the red circle is at the gap below the secundum edge, labelled 'foramen ovale'. 'channel past flap' and 'primum = flap' identify the flap, though the flap itself has no direct label

postnatal closure: ok - stage 4 shows primum and secundum fused, labelled 'fused wall' and 'fossa ovalis'. The note that LA pressure shuts the flap after birth and RA pressure holds it open before birth is correct
stage count and order: ok - 4 stages in the correct sequence (primum, secundum holes, foramen ovale, after birth)
view and spelling: ok - 'from RA' view and all label spellings are correct; no impossible anatomy found
